notes: RED baseline (Sanjay, 2026-10-05, verbatim): 'somebody wants to build their own portfolio or an e-commerce project, and now they don't actually know what agents or what model is best for them to work with' and 'we want to make sure that the plans it is generating are as per the user's requirement. Please have some follow-up questions'. Design point 4 (approved): keys never go into chat. Every prompt pastes its scenario; none reads live repo state.

should_trigger: which free AI models can I use to build this?
split this e-commerce build across several free models running in parallel
should_not_trigger: what is a large language model?
